node.title: Constructor fails with Undefined subroutine when called as new Foo()
node.author: aguidrevitch
node.doctext: Here is the problem I'm experiencing Undefined subroutine &Net::FTPServer::InMem::FileHandle called at /usr/local/share/perl/5.18.2/Net/FTPServer/InMem/DirHandle.pm line 274, line 6. at /usr/local/share/perl/5.18.2/Net/FTPServer.pm line 2368, line 6. Net::FTPServer::__ANON__('Undefined subroutine &Net::FTPServer::InMem::FileHandle calle...') called at /usr/local/share/perl/5.18.2/Net/FTPServer/InMem/DirHandle.pm line 274 Net::FTPServer::InMem::DirHandle::list_status('Net::FTPServer::InMem::DirHandle=HASH(0x2a725a8)', undef) called at /usr/local/share/perl/5.18.2/Net/FTPServer/DirHandle.pm line 171 Net::FTPServer::DirHandle::_list_status('Net::FTPServer::InMem::DirHandle=HASH(0x2a725a8)', undef) called at /usr/local/share/perl/5.18.2/Net/FTPServer.pm line 5899 Net::FTPServer::_LIST_command('Net::FTPServer::Opencart=HASH(0x2a38908)', 'LIST', '-la') called at /usr/local/share/perl/5.18.2/Net/FTPServer.pm line 3004 Net::FTPServer::run('Net::FTPServer::Opencart') called at ./ftp-server.pl line 220 The Net::FTPServer::InMem::FileHandle is listed in %INC. If I replace my $fileh = new Net::FTPServer::InMem::FileHandle with my $fileh = Net::FTPServer::InMem::FileHandle->new right in the Net::FTPServer::InMem::DirHandle at line 274, it starts to work. What's wrong ? How can I fix that ?
